semiconductor_relevance: High — First Technology China Ltd. provides a range of equipment and integrated solutions specifically for the semiconductor and electronics manufacturing sectors.
summary: First Technology China Ltd. (FTCL) is an integrated solution and service provider focused on the semiconductor and electronics industries in Greater China. They offer equipment, process expertise, and customized engineering solutions to enhance manufacturing efficiency across various sectors, including advanced packaging and power semiconductor testing.

regional_presence.China: FTCL operates primarily in Greater China, providing tailored solutions to local manufacturers.
